description: This Java class defines configuration properties for the AuthenticationServer, including signing properties and permissions resource location used by the FileBasedAuthenticationService.

classes.name: AuthenticationServerConfigProperties
classes.description: Holds configuration properties for authentication server, including signing configurations and permissions resource location.

methods.name: getSigning
methods.description: Returns the signing configuration properties used for creating tokens.

methods.name: getValidation
methods.description: Returns the signing configuration properties used for validating tokens issued by this service.

methods.name: getPermissionsPath
methods.description: Returns the resource location from which authorization rules are loaded.

methods.name: setPermissionsPath
methods.description: Sets the resource location for authorization rules; throws NullPointerException if null.
